findings.description: Legacy relation endpoint-kind validation lacks a deletion-sensitive negative control. The endpoint matrix constructs only RelationClaimV2 records; legacy controls use missing/null/integer fields or valid endpoints. I disabled only the 'relation endpoint kind' guard for RelationClaim and replayed the focused controls: all 553 direct and 551 in-memory SQLite cases still passed. With that mutation, a legacy supports relation whose subject is a correctly resolved MediaAsset and object is a Hypothesis returns no diagnostics and usable support. The unchanged implementation correctly reports INTEGRITY_FAILURE at the legacy relation's subject with reason 'relation endpoint kind'. Thus this is a demonstrated coverage gap, not a claim that the unchanged implementation accepts that record.
